items.title: Charles River Laboratories International (CRL) Stock Fair Value Rises After Analysts Lift Targets
items.summary: The analyst fair value estimate for Charles River Laboratories International has shifted from US$230.93 to US$282.43, a change of about 22% in the updated work. That move sits against Street commentary that now ranges from targets in the low US$200s to just above US$300. This reflects both renewed optimism around growth execution and ongoing discussion about valuation and timing. As you read on, you will see how this evolving price target story fits into the broader narrative and what signals...
